subject: Input files are not uploaded - no error in logs

messages.author: 63a8a907e46f9a9d
messages.subject: Input files are not uploaded - no error in logs
parts:
This is my third application - https://languagevariationsuite.shinyapps.io/TextMiningBeta/. There was no error in deployment as well as it runs fine locally. However, functions for uploading files are not reactive - it prints only the name of the file without passing its content - you can see it from the screenshot (the bar did not load). On my shiny server log - there is no error messages (just: listening, starting R with ID and versions for shiny, R etc). Could anyone  suggest how to debug the deployment? I have tested on chrome, safari and firefox and also with different computers. I used new rsconnect package on one computer and also older  shinyapps package to deploy.
Thanks!
